abstract: OBJECTIVE: To determine the frequency, clinical presentation and management outcomes of Gestational Trophoblastic Disease (GTD). STUDY DESIGN: Descriptive case series. PLACE AND DURATION: Department of Gynaecology and Obstetrics, Liaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences, Jamshoro, from March 2003 to March 2004. PATIENTS AND METHODS: The case records of all the gestational trophoblastic cases during study period were analyzed regarding their illness history, clinical examination, investigations, treatment and follow-up. The main outcomes were measured in terms of duration, antecedent pregnancy, investigations, treatment and the follow-up. RESULTS: There were a total of 1030 obstetric admissions during the study period, which included 23 cases of trophoblastic disease. Hence, frequency of GTD was 1 per 45 live births. Of these 23 cases, 19 (82.6%) patients had hydatidiform mole and 4 patients had malignant trophoblastic disease. Eight patients (34.7%) received chemotherapy while rest of the patients had suction evacuation and follow-up. Among all patients, 21 (91.3%) fully recovered and 2 (8.69%) died because of extensive disease; metastasis extending upto brain. CONCLUSION: Frequency of trophoblastic disease was high in this series compared to world and national literature. Therefore, emphasis should be on the early diagnosis of disease as proper management in the early stages strongly influences the outcome of disease. Suction evacuation and follow-up are ideal treatments for benign trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の頻度、臨床像、管理転帰を明らかにすること。研究デザイン：記述的症例集積。実施場所・期間：2003年3月から2004年3月まで、ジャムショロのLiaquat University of Medical and Health Sciences産婦人科。対象と方法：研究期間中のすべての絨毛性疾患症例のカルテを、病歴、臨床所見、検査、治療、フォローアップの観点から解析した。主要アウトカムは、期間、先行妊娠、検査、治療、フォローアップの観点から測定した。結果：研究期間中の産科入院は合計1030件で、そのうち絨毛性疾患23例が含まれた。したがって、GTDの頻度は出生45例に1例であった。23例中19例（82.6%）が胞状奇胎、4例が悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患であった。8例（34.7%）が化学療法を受け、残りの患者は吸引掻爬とフォローアップを受けた。全患者のうち21例（91.3%）が完全に回復し、2例（8.69%）が広範な病変により死亡した。死因は脳転移の進展であった。結論：本シリーズの絨毛性疾患の頻度は、世界および国内の文献と比較して高かった。したがって、早期診断を重視すべきである。早期段階での適切な管理は転帰に強く影響する。吸引掻爬とフォローアップは良性絨毛性疾患に対する理想的な治療である。
